description: Create an unpaid draft order with quotes: uploads and checks the PDF, validates the address and returns a quote per shipping method. Nothing is bought; use order_purchase for that.

client_ref.description: Your reference; re-running create with the same one returns the same order.

deliver_by.description: Deadline (YYYY-MM-DD); used to rank quotes, never a guarantee.

file.description: Print-ready PDF, as an https URL it can be downloaded from (at most 32 MB), or the id (fil_…) of a file sent before.

max_total.description: Budget in the order's currency (USD, in the US and Hong Kong), e.g. 450; quotes above it are flagged.

note.description: Your note, kept on the order.

option.description: Filter by any option, as key=value. Repeatable.

pickup.description: Collect from a pickup point instead of door delivery: a pkp_… id from `pickup-points`, "nearest", or "door" to switch back.

product.description: Product id or alias, e.g. flyer.

qty.description: Quantity; must be one the product offers.

ship_to.description: Delivery address: a JSON file, inline JSON, or - for stdin. As an object: US {name, line1, city, state, postal_code}; Hong Kong {name, line1, district, area, phone, email, country: "HK"}.

name: order_create
